A5 Notebook & Premium Diaries With Logo – Customizable Notepad for Corporate Gifting

If you’re looking for a stylish, practical, and brand-forward writing companion, our A5 Notebook & Premium Diaries With Logo collection is the perfect choice. Designed with a premium look notebook in A5 size, these diaries offer the ideal blend of sophistication and utility. Whether used as corporate giveaways, employee welcome kits, event merchandise, or promotional gifts, these notebooks help elevate your brand presence while offering a high-quality writing experience. The notebook’s refined design, functional layout, and smooth writing paper make it a standout accessory for professionals, students, and business teams.With a strong focus on aesthetics, the diary features an elegant two tone side stitching that adds a modern and premium appeal. The convenient pen slot on notebook spine ensures that your pen stays secure and accessible at all times – perfect for meetings, travel, and daily use. The elastic band fastener provides durability while keeping the notebook neatly closed, making it easy to carry in bags without causing wear or losing sheets.

This customizable notepad is crafted with a total of 176 writing pages with 80 GSM paper, ensuring a smooth, bleed-resistant writing experience. The pages are structured for both personal and professional use, making it ideal for journaling, planning, jotting meeting notes, or project documentation. It also includes a dedicated section with personal memorandum, calendar, etc., helping users stay organized throughout the year. The built-in bookmark ribbon adds further convenience, allowing users to mark important pages instantly.

These premium diaries with logo support multiple branding options such as UV printing, embossing, debossing, screen printing, and foil stamping—making them one of the most versatile corporate gifting choices. A branded A5 diary not only enhances your professional image but also helps reinforce brand recall in everyday work environments. With increasing demand for customized corporate stationery, businesses prefer gifting notebooks that are functional, stylish, and memorable. Our premium A5 are designed exactly for that purpose.

The category has become a top choice for organizations aiming to offer high-value gifts while maintaining affordability. Its size is perfect — compact enough to carry, yet spacious enough for daily writing needs. The elegant detailing, premium binding, and long-lasting materials make it a reliable option for executives, sales teams, HR kits, seminars, conferences, and festive gifting.

Key Features of A5 Notebook & Premium Diaries With Logo

  • Premium look notebook in A5 size with a stylish and modern finish
  • Elegant two tone side stitching for a refined touch
  • Pen slot on notebook spine for convenience and accessibility
  • Elastic band fastener to keep the notebook secure
  • Contains total 176 writing pages with high-quality 80 GSM paper
  • Includes a section with personal memorandum, calendar, etc.
  • Comes with a bookmark ribbon for easy navigation
  • Customizable notepad with logo branding options for corporates

Whether you’re looking for branded stationery, employee welcome kit essentials, or elegant corporate giveaways, our collection offers the perfect blend of quality, functionality, and aesthetic appeal. Enhance your brand image with a notebook that speaks professionalism and style.
